verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm Insomnia supports HTTP, gRPC, GraphQL, and WebSocket requests (insomnia-docs-15), with dedicated gRPC support including Protobuf uploads (insomnia-docs-7, insomnia-docs-27, insomnia-docs-43) and GraphQL-specific tooling like auto-completion and linting (insomnia-docs-26).
